'''Borotavi syndrome''' was a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] disease caused by eating a deadly [[Shellfish/Legends|shellfish]] on [[Pamina Prime]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]] was diagnosed with this disease after eating a local blue-shelled mollusk with a green stripe.
